description:
Young-Soo has a secret. He hates frogs. No wait, actually his real secret is…that he’s gay! But things are looking up because he’s finally broken free from his parents' house and gotten a place of his own. There’s just one issue. His new apartment actually came with a roommate, his childhood classmate, Eun-Sung! And not only did he get scammed into getting a place with an unexpected roommate, it’s the kid who gave him frog trauma in the first place! On top of all this, Eun-Sung’s a cop in a unit formed to crackdown on homosexuality. Plus, Young-Soo’s longtime friend, Ji-Ho, can’t help but give Eun-Sung the side-eye as well… Something’s definitely gotta give and someone just might end up cuffed. It’s just a matter of whether that’s a good thing or a bad thing...

(Source: Lezhin US)
